summary: 16-year-old Grand Junction boy killed in a ~100-ft fall at the Independence Monument Overlook; he was outside the enclosed viewpoint and lost his footing at the cliff edge; conscious when first responders reached him, he succumbed to traumatic injuries before medical help could arrive.
